supersedes_clauses.revision_reason: Round-3 decision-semantics audit (Branch A) proved the argmax-ĥ clause violated frozen A0G selector semantics (argmin predicted Delta L over j=0..4 with no-op). The clause and the implementation had drifted together. Original text preserved in that file and in L2_CONTRACT_AUDIT.md; this contract replaces it for the new batch only.

semantics.action_0: no-op: NO additional intervention; continue the original training update (NOT skipping the optimizer step)
semantics.action_j_positive: at post-unscale/pre-clip, exactly ONE optimizer step at horizon h=1: g' = g + lambda*(g_j - g); afterwards resume the perturbed trajectory normally
semantics.lambda_rule: one common positive lambda for all non-zero actions, fixed
semantics.hhat_semantics: dL_score/dlambda (Case 1; no sign transform, no utility transform)
semantics.tie_break: exact A0G comparison, lowest action_id; NO floating-point rounding, no tolerance-tie, no gain threshold introduced
semantics.lambda_note: the common positive lambda does not change ranking; the old program's error was argmax plus dropping no-op, NOT omitting lambda in ranking
semantics.score_outputs: persist hhat, lambda*hhat and -lambda*hhat per action with explicit units (loss per unit lambda; loss; loss)

revoked_clauses.clause: must choose_noop=False AND every unit Gain>0
revoked_clauses.reason: no-op is a legal output with Gain=0; per-unit mandatory positive gain is not required by A0G frozen semantics (A0G itself chose no-op 6/360 at method C). All-no-op is NOT a positive result; harmful actions are counted honestly.

early_stop_meaning: stopping per pre-registered conditions is not a protocol violation and does not imply all stages completed

numerical_gate.source: frozen A0H-1.5 round-2 B1 gate as actually applied to the FP32-HVP candidate (a0h15_accept_aprime_v01.py L35; PREREGISTRATION.md 'L1 numerics'); thresholds parsed from artifacts, not fitted
numerical_gate.scope: all 4 active actions at H=4 (decision horizon); H=1/H=8 diffs reported as diagnostic
numerical_gate.finite_check: all scores/losses/diffs/thresholds must pass isfinite; threshold non-negative; NaN/Inf -> NON_FINITE, blocked from gate/aggregation/argmin
numerical_gate.claim_limit: pass means same-config implementation agreement only; NOT native-derivative absolute correctness

methods.replay: native +lambda real replay, 5 actions per unit, single pass computing V_score and V_eval separately per branch
methods.adjoint_constraint: adjoint_only must NOT depend on candidate future tangents to build w0 and must not hide a joint forward; forward reference is a separate audit-cost run; mode fingerprints + call counters persisted
methods.eval_isolation: V_eval per-candidate labels computed in the same pass but written to a separate module/file; selectors/thresholds/sample selection never read eval; analysis reads eval only after ALL choices are locked

batch_plan.reduced_batch_rule: if only 3-5 eligible states, register the full eligible set x2 streams BEFORE opening any result; if <3 states or any state lacks 2 legal streams -> NO_ELIGIBLE_BATCH (deliver ledger+manifest only)
batch_plan.selection_rule: sort eligible states by (train_seed, true optimizer step, checkpoint ID); round-robin across seeds; per state take the first 2 streams in stable registered stream-ID order; selection by identity/availability/exposure ONLY - never by hhat/gain/loss/history
batch_plan.seed_short_rule: <3 seeds does not auto-block but must be registered with tightened interpretation

analysis_plan.main_endpoint: FP32 adjoint chosen action's V_eval Gain: per-state mean over its 2 streams, then equal weight over states; ALL units incl. no-op and harmful

bootstrap.pairing: same action labels and methods paired
bootstrap.single_seed_rule: no seed-level interval if only 1 seed
bootstrap.interpretation: exploratory uncertainty only; stream count != independent seed count; favorable proportion is NOT a frequentist p-value

utility_pilot_labels.NOT_COVERED: utility stage not entered per pre-registered branch
utility_pilot_labels.POSITIVE/ZERO/NEGATIVE_POINT_ESTIMATE: complete; by main endpoint mean sign

analysis_plan.no_translation: the label never means 'proven significantly better than all methods'
analysis_plan.failure_attribution_limit: observational localization only: lambda*hhat vs delta_L_score then delta_L_score vs delta_L_eval; NO lambda/nonlinearity/proxy-failure claims without magnitude or native-derivative probe evidence; no immediate retuning/re-candidating/A-triple-prime

budget.scope: dev rehearsal + all acceptance GPU work, summed
